title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 12
description:
At Jeminise, we understand the passion for baseball, and this Comforter Set is designed for every baseball player, fan, and lover. It offers a cozy retreat with a personalized touch, making it a thoughtful gift for any occasion.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: Celebrate determination and love for baseball with a bedding set that speaks volumes.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features environmental protection techniques to prevent fading and ensure smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting enjoyment.
  • Soft & Comfy Material: Made from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric with Whole-Piece Microfiber Filling for softness, comfort, durability, and lightweight feel.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, dries quickly, and maintains fluffiness. It's recommended to wash in a mesh laundry bag.
  • Custom Options: Personalize with custom name text inputs, making it a unique gift for men, women, moms, dads, and more.
  • Versatile Use: Perfect for all seasons, offering breathable comfort year-round.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Design Personalized Baseball Bedding Set
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Multiple Size
Special Feature Breathable
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Closure Type Zipper
Thread Count 400
